name: app-user-flow-diagram-with-pill-nodes
title: User flow map with pill nodes branching from an onboarding phone
whatItIs: A light grey slide titled 'User Flow'. A large charcoal card holds an onboarding phone; thin connector lines branch to dark pills (Sign Up, Dashboard, Manage Cards, Analytics...) and lighter outlined pills for sub-steps that fade off the right edge.
whatItMeans: Clear and elegant; solid vs outlined nodes show primary vs secondary steps and the fading edge implies a larger system.
techniques: Use filled pills for main destinations and outlined pills for sub-actions.
Draw connectors as soft rounded elbow lines.
Fade the far nodes to imply continuation off the page.
Place a real screen in a dark container as the start of the flow.

vocabulary.definition: A diagram of paths a user takes through a product.
A rounded label representing a screen or step.
A line with right-angle rounded bends.
Elements that fade at the frame to imply more.
